title: Mobile Horizons
description: Experience stunning shaders, massive render distances, and optimization on your mobile Java launcher!
body:
🌅 Mobile Horizons

the ultimate visual and performance-focused Fabric modpack crafted specifically to elevate your Minecraft Java experience on mobile launchers (such as Zalith Launcher 2 and Pojav).
Why settle for flat, low-render-distance gameplay on your phone when you can experience a breathtaking, modern Java world in the palm of your hand? This pack carefully balances stunning graphics with top-tier optimization.

🚀 Key Features
🌌 Next-Gen Render Distance (Distant Horizons)
Experience massive, sweeping vistas with Distant Horizons. Using advanced Level of Detail (LOD) chunk generation, you can view landscapes stretching out for hundreds of blocks without lagging or overheating your mobile device.

✨ Premium Shaders (Pre-configured)
This pack comes packed with a handpicked selection of shaders optimized for various mobile hardware capabilities:
High End: Complementary Shaders (Reimagined & Unbound) and BSL Shaders for incredible water reflection, waving foliage, and realistic clouds.
Performance/Low End: Potato Shaders, MakeUp-UltraFast, and Mellow Shaders to give you beautiful lighting without sacrificing your frame rate.

⚡ Elite Optimization (Lag-Free Mobile Play)
To make Minecraft Java run smoothly on mobile processors and limited memory, we've integrated the best modern optimization engine:
FPS Boosters: Sodium, Sodium Extra, and ImmediatelyFast.
Physics & Logic: Lithium and FerriteCore (minimizes RAM footprint dramatically).
Smart Rendering: Entity Culling and More Culling to make sure your device only renders what you can actually see.
BadOptimizations & Dynamic FPS to squeeze out every drop of performance.

🎨 Beautiful, Alive Visuals & Animations
Mobs with Personality: Fully integrated with Fresh Animations (and player animation attachments) to make animals, villagers, and monsters move realistically.
3D Detailing: Includes Round Trees, Better Leaves, and Fancy Crops to make nature feel organic instead of blocky.
Underground Life: Features NewGlowingOres so you can find minerals easier in the dark, and Invisible Item Frames for cleaner base building.

🧭 Adventure, Reimagined
Explore completely redesigned dimensions and complex dungeons:
World Gen: Overhauled worlds featuring Terralith (stunning overworld biomes), Incendium (epic Nether redesign), and Dungeons & Taverns for rich exploration.
Navigation: Stay oriented with Xaero’s Minimap and Xaero's World Map.
QoL & Exploration: Features Traveler's Backpack for extra storage on the go, FallingTree for realistic lumberjacking, and Sound Physics Remastered for rich, echoing cave acoustics.

🔧 Recommended Settings for Mobile Launchers
set the frame rate to 30fps on mid range devices like poco x7 pro ( dimensity 8400 ultra )
Allocated RAM: 4GB to 6GB is highly recommended for optimal performance.
use MobileGlues and copy these settings for MobileGlues


Max GLSL Cache Size (enter -1 to disable)

512mb.

Use ANGLE as OpenGL ES driver

Disable.

OpenGL Error Setting

Auto.

MultiDraw Emulation

Auto.

Custom target OpenGL Version

OpenGL 4.6.

ANGLE Depth Clear Workaround

Disable.

Enable Incomplete ARB_compute_shader Extension
= ON.

Disable Recommended timer_query Extension
= ON.
Enable Advanced direct_state_access Extension
= OFF.
(Experimental) Enable built in FSR1
= OFF.

Engine: Fabric (Minecraft 1.21.8)
wait for at least 3 minutes for the fps to become stable. 
Launcher: Fully tested and built for Zalith Launcher 2.
Enjoy a limitless horizon right from your phone!
